Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition EHDSDischargeReport

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
EHDSDischargeReport 0..*EHDSDocumentDischarge report model

Elements defined in Ancestors:header, header, presentedForm
EHDSDischargeReport.header 1..1BaseDischarge report Document header.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.author[x] 1..*EHDSHealthProfessional, EHDSOrganisation, EHDSDeviceAuthor of the document.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.documentCategory 1..1CodeableConceptBroad category of document (e.g. 34105-7 Hospital discharge summary).
EHDSDischargeReport.header.documentType 1..1CodeableConceptType of document (e.g. 34106-5 Physician hospital discharge summary).
EHDSDischargeReport.header.documentTitle 1..1stringHuman-readable document title that may be displayed in search results etc. This may be documentType’s display name or it may contain further information. Example: ‘Hospital discharge report. Jane Green. 7.10.2025-10.10.2025’.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.period 0..1PeriodTime period of information covered in the document.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.legalAuthentication 0..*BaseDocument legal authentication details.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.legalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x] 1..1EHDSHealthProfessional, EHDSOrganisationThe person or organisation taking responsibility for the content of the document.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.legalAuthentication.dateTime 1..1dateTimeDate and time when the document was authenticated.
EHDSDischargeReport.header.eventCategory 0..*CodeableConceptCategorisation of the event covered by the document (e.g. discharge type). Selection of such tags or labels depends on the use case and agreement between data-sharing parties. This metadata element serves primarily for searching and filtering purposes.
Binding Description: (required) ⚠: SNOMED GPS (preferred), LOINC
EHDSDischargeReport.header.intendedRecipient[x] 0..*Intended recipient of the information, i.e. a person or organisation that shall be notified or be aware of the content. This element is used to indicate explicit communication intent and does not represent routine storage or passive availability of information (e.g. in portals).
EHDSDischargeReport.header.intendedRecipient[x].intendedRecipientEHDSRelatedPersonEHDSRelatedPerson
EHDSDischargeReport.header.intendedRecipient[x].intendedRecipientEHDSHealthProfessionalEHDSHealthProfessional
EHDSDischargeReport.header.intendedRecipient[x].intendedRecipientEHDSOrganisationEHDSOrganisation
EHDSDischargeReport.presentedForm 0..*EHDSAttachmentA narrative easy-to-read representation of the full dataset, e.g. PDF version of a document. At least one of body or presentedForm shall be present.
EHDSDischargeReport.body 0..1BaseDischarge report structured body. At least one of body or presentedForm shall be present.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.alerts 0..1BaseSection: Alerts.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.alerts.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.alerts.medicalAlert 0..*EHDSAlertMedical alerts relevant in the context of the encounter.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.encounterInformation 1..1BaseSection: Encounter information.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.encounterInformation.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.encounterInformation.encounter 1..1EHDSEncounterEncounter information.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.encounterInformation.note 0..1stringFree text notes by the health professional.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation 0..1BaseSection: Admission evaluation. Admission evaluation section shall be reported only if it is relevant to ensure continuity of care.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation.objectiveFindings 0..*EHDSObservationObjective findings, such as anthropometric measurements, vital signs or objective anatomical findings of physical examination.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation.functionalStatus[x] 0..*An individual’s ability to perform normal daily activities required to meet basic needs, fulfil usual roles and maintain health and well-being.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation.functionalStatus[x].functionalStatusEHDSConditionEHDSCondition
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation.functionalStatus[x].functionalStatusEHDSObservationEHDSObservation
EHDSDischargeReport.body.admissionEvaluation.note 0..1stringFree text notes by the evaluation performer.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory 0..1BaseSection: Patient health history (anamnesis) containing only information that is highly relevant to this specific episode of care. The model is designed with the expectation that the patient summary is available.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section. If the section includes structured information, it shall also be included in generatedNarrative.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.pastProblems[x] 0..*A list of conditions that a patient suffered from in the past or still suffers from. Unlike the diagnostic summary, the medical history is not only a list of problems but may also contain a broader description of the condition and its progress, details about treatment, including medication and patient response to treatment. The past problem section (unlike the same section of the patient summary) shall include only conditions that are important for continuity of care. This section, if provided, complements the diagnostic summary section of the discharge report.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.pastProblems[x].pastProblemsEHDSConditionEHDSCondition
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.pastProblems[x].pastProblemsEHDSObservationEHDSObservation
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.devicesAndImplants 0..*EHDSDeviceUseDevices and implants in patient anamnesis.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.procedures 0..*EHDSProcedureProcedures in patient anamnesis.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.patientHistory.note 0..1stringFree text notes by the health professional.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter 1..1BaseSection: Course of inpatient or outpatient encounter.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.conditionSummary 1..*EHDSConditionConditions that were treated or affected provisioning of care (diagnostics, therapy, nursing, monitoring) during the encounter. At least one attended condition shall be marked. Other conditions are recorded only if they are important for continuity of care (after discharge).
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.procedures 0..*EHDSProcedureProcedures performed during encounter which are significant for continuity of care, e.g. surgeries and other instrumental interventions (endoscopic, intravascular), chemotherapy, radiotherapy, purification methods (dialysis, haemoperfusion), circulation support methods (counterpulsation etc.), administration of blood derivatives or others. Diagnostic procedures are typically captured as observation results and not repeated here.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.medicalDevicesAndImplants 0..*EHDSDeviceUseMedical devices (including implants) whose use was started, stopped or otherwise modified during the encounter.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.pharmacotherapy 0..*EHDSMedicationUseSignificant medication treatments during encounter.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.objectiveFindings 0..*EHDSObservationObjective findings, such as anthropometric measurements, vital signs or objective anatomical findings of physical examination. The line between objective findings and test results is not clear and it is up to the implementers to decide how to logically display different measurements.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.testResults[x] 0..*Significant medical test results of functional, diagnostic (including laboratory) and imaging examinations performed during encounter.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.testResults[x].testResultsEHDSObservationEHDSObservation
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.testResults[x].testResultsEHDSLaboratoryObservationEHDSLaboratoryObservation
EHDSDischargeReport.body.courseOfEncounter.note 0..1stringFree text notes by the health professional.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails 0..1BaseSection: Discharge details.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails.objectiveFindings 0..*EHDSObservationObjective findings, such as anthropometric measurements, vital signs or objective anatomical findings of physical examination.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails.functionalStatus[x] 0..*An individual’s ability to perform normal daily activities required to meet basic needs, fulfil usual roles and maintain health and well-being.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails.functionalStatus[x].functionalStatusEHDSConditionEHDSCondition
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails.functionalStatus[x].functionalStatusEHDSObservationEHDSObservation
EHDSDischargeReport.body.dischargeDetails.note 0..1stringFree text notes by the health professional.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.medicationSummary 0..1BaseSummary information on the medication recommended for the period after discharge, indicating whether the medication is changed or newly started. Compared to previous practices, the overview is supplemented with medication that has been discontinued.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.medicationSummary.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.medicationSummary.medicationUse 0..*EHDSMedicationUseDetails about medication and dosage.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.medicationSummary.note 0..1stringFree text notes by the health professional.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.carePlan 0..1BaseSection: Care plan and other recommendations after discharge.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.carePlan.generatedNarrative 0..1NarrativeNarrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section.
This profile does not constrain the narrative in regard to content, language, or traceability to data elements
EHDSDischargeReport.body.carePlan.structuredCarePlan 0..*EHDSCarePlanStructured care plan after discharge.
EHDSDischargeReport.body.carePlan.otherRecommendations 0..1stringOther recommendations (advice) after discharge, e.g. recommendation to suggest hip replacement, reduce number of cigarettes, stop smoking, increase physical exercise.
EHDSDischargeReport.attachment 0..*EHDSAttachmentReport attachment.
